sent_to_model:
My father is in hospital in the Netherlands and I am taking the train tonight, I don't know for how long. This means Inês has to do the launch on Thursday without me, and I found the error in figure 3 only this afternoon, so I am leaving her a real mess. Please write a handover page for her in the launch folder on the drive, everything is in there and in my inbox. She needs to know what to do and in which order, but I also want her to hear from me that I trust her completely and that I am sorry. Put it as a draft, I will read it on the train before I share it. Family stuff stays out apart from the basics. Use docs/climate-programme/border-revenues-launch/handover as the target for the new page.

- Inês knows the paper as well as I do, she ran the annex B sensitivity runs herself
- Geert knows I am away, he can sign off a corrected press release if Hanna needs a senior name
- in Lisbon at the COP side event she rescued my panel when the projector died, she is better live than she thinks
- the 2.1 mistake is mine, not hers, she should say so if anyone asks
- Kessler will try to make it about the 80% pass-through, she should not let him set the tone
- only "my father is ill, I am with my family", nothing more about him
- she can call me but after 9 tomorrow I might not pick up

(About me: climate-policy researcher at a think tank, 39, Brussels, Belgium. Length: all the messages together should come to roughly 800-2,000 words.)
